text:
```yaml
name: Repomix

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  repomix:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install Repomix
        run: pip install repomix

      - name: Pack repository with Repomix
        run: repomix pack . --compression

      - name: Upload repomix output
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: repomix-output
          path: repomix.zip
          retention-days: 7
```
